title: Validate synthetic augmentation provenance and patient splits
prompt: Validate and assemble augmentation manifests. Rows are dicts with id,patient; synthetic rows additionally list source_patients and pseudo_labeler_training_patients. Reject duplicate IDs or ANY held-out patient in training/provenance. Return shallow copies of real-only and augmented manifests. This split/provenance core does not train a DDPM or assert augmentation benefit.

resources.title: Cross-validation: group splitters (scikit-learn)
resources.why: GroupKFold keeps all samples from one group on the same side of the split.
